preReg.miss: P1 or P2 miss, or any guardrail miss → NO-GO (killed at pilot, layer deleted)
preReg.substrate: FEASTSCALE_R13=1 both sides; armed adds FEASTCOST=1; identical seeds (paired)
preReg.guardrails: G1 national+≥control−2; G2 table≥control−2; G3 median survival≥control−10d; G4 no new death mode; G5 median feast count ≥0.8×control
